title: Dreamy Portrait with Soft Focus
coreRelationships: The figure's head is tilted downwards and to the right, resting on an arm or shoulder, creating a curved line.
The face is blurred and indistinct, with closed eyes, suggesting repose or introspection.
The background is a soft, light blur, contrasting with the darker tones of the figure.
The entire image is characterized by a strong soft-focus effect and visible grain, contributing to a dreamlike quality.
